description: Local-first registry for optional Estate interaction adapters. Adapters may present, transport, or capture interactions, but institutional records remain in governed Estate artifacts.

adapters.authority_boundary: Displays and routes steward actions through existing command center, Alfred, mailbox, work package, and audit flows.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Does not own institutional records; reads local registries, mailboxes, runtime summaries, and governed artifacts.
adapters.notes: Significant UI actions must create or update auditable Estate artifacts through existing services.

adapters.authority_boundary: Delivers notifications only; routing authority remains with notification_router and Alfred-approved workflows.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Notifications are not records of authority; canonical records remain in mailboxes, work packages, ledgers, and audit artifacts.
adapters.notes: Secrets are supplied by the runtime environment and are never stored in this registry.

adapters.authority_boundary: Transcribes input only; spoken commands must be planned through Alfred before action.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Transcripts are audit artifacts when written; they do not replace governed records.
adapters.notes: Safe local test adapter for graceful voice workflows without external providers.

adapters.authority_boundary: Synthesizes responses only and cannot execute Estate actions.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Audio or speech output is presentational; canonical records remain in Estate artifacts.
adapters.notes: Safe local test adapter for TTS surfaces.

adapters.authority_boundary: Conversation surface can draft exchanges but must route Estate actions to Alfred, mailboxes, or governed work packages.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Conversation output is not institutional memory unless promoted into an auditable Estate artifact.
adapters.notes: Placeholder surface for local conversation testing.

adapters.authority_boundary: Finds and opens local Estate artifacts; mutating commands must route through governed services.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Search index and command palette output are discovery aids, not records of authority.
adapters.notes: Commands should degrade to no results when supporting indexes are absent.

adapters.authority_boundary: Provides activity visibility only; decisions and assignments remain with established operations governance.
adapters.source_of_truth_boundary: Activity events summarize local artifacts and do not supersede source documents.
adapters.notes: Missing event sources should yield empty activity streams rather than errors.
